sections.heading: Company Profile
paragraphs: NSP stands for Hong Kong Natural Science Press. Specializing in academic publishing, we operate under an open access (OA) model and are committed to delivering high-quality academic publishing services to researchers worldwide. Leveraging Hong Kong's international advantages, we actively promote local research findings to a global audience while proactively introducing cutting-edge academic resources from overseas, building a comprehensive publishing system covering life sciences, earth sciences, engineering, and technology. Through digital technologies and multilingual platforms, we break down geographical barriers and facilitate the flow of knowledge, fostering deep connections within the global scientific community with professionalism and rigor, and continuously driving the advancement of international scholarship.

sections.heading: Mission
paragraphs: Upholding academic integrity, driving the global flow of knowledge.

We are committed to transforming cutting-edge research into practical professional insights, empowering institutions, scholars, and industry decision-makers with clear intellectual guidance in a complex world.

sections.heading: Vision
paragraphs: To become the premier gateway for academic exchange between East and West.

We do more than define academic standards—we are committed to building a borderless knowledge infrastructure, enabling rigorous ideas to transcend geographical boundaries and nourish a more resilient global intellectual community.

openAccess.title: Open Access
openAccess.intro: Open access is a fundamental movement for sharing and circulating academic information — making peer-reviewed scholarship freely available to anyone, anywhere, without subscription or paywall.

points.title: Copyright
points.body: Authors retain copyright of their work, which is published under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license (CC BY 4.0).

points.title: Rights
points.body: Users are permitted to copy, distribute, and adapt the work for non-commercial purposes, provided the original work is properly cited.

points.title: License Details
points.body: The published work is free to read, copy, and distribute. Authors retain publishing rights without restrictions, but reuse of images, figures, or other content must credit the original source.

items.title: High Visibility and High Impact
items.body: Extends the citation reach and global impact of academic articles.

items.title: Reuse with Proper Citation
items.body: Allows others to reuse, circulate, and build upon the research.

items.title: Rigorous Peer Review
items.body: Guarantees the academic quality of every article through peer review.

items.title: No Length Limitation
items.body: Articles are published completely as written, with no artificial page limits.

items.title: Rapid Publication
items.body: A continuous publication model ensures fast online availability.

people.name: Aixu Chen
people.bio: A physicist by training with extensive academic experience across condensed-matter and applied optics, Aixu leads NSP's editorial direction — shaping policy, recruiting subject editors, and ensuring every title upholds the rigor expected of a peer-reviewed open-access publisher.

people.name: Ming Qi
people.bio: With a background in mechanical engineering and several years of hands-on scientific research, Ming oversees day-to-day editorial operations across the journal portfolio, coordinating peer review, copyediting, and the production pipeline that brings accepted manuscripts online.

people.name: Jiajie Liu
people.bio: Trained in physics and seasoned in academic publishing, Jiajie manages submissions, reviewer engagement, and author communications — keeping the path from submission to publication transparent, predictable, and as short as quality allows.

people.name: Deping Zhang
people.bio: Member of the European Academy of Sciences. Deping advises NSP on long-range editorial strategy and the cultivation of cross-disciplinary research communities.

people.name: Yue Kiat Soon
people.bio: Research Fellow in the Department of Engineering Science at the University of Oxford. Yue Kiat advises on engineering-domain journals and the integration of computational methods into our editorial workflow.

people.name: Jiang Xie
people.bio: Researcher in the International Research Center for Renewable Energy at Xi'an Jiaotong University. Jiang advises NSP on renewable-energy and sustainability programs across our journal portfolio.
